title: Lunchline philosophy
description: A values section: a tiny tracked eyebrow, a large light two-line heading, then a numbered accordion of bold principles starting a quarter of the way across on wide screens, split by citron hairlines, each with a + that turns to × when opened. The heading's letters rise in, the rows fade in from 24px to the right one after another, and the top hairline draws itself out.
notes: the rows are <details> elements: no JavaScript, keyboard-accessible
numbers come from the order of the items
